sourceName: Mercedes-Benz Croatian Vito technical price list, identity fields only
applicability: Manufacturer catalogue valid from 1 March 2024 identifies diesel Vito 110 CDI panel vans, 1950 cc and 75 kW/102 PS. This verifies existence of the application, not ATM missing displacement, its erroneous petrol label, the Shiftech 280 Nm stock value, or a pre-2024 engine period.
notes: Hash covers actual rendered public page/PDF extraction. Only factual identity and availability notes retained. No prices or marketing copied.

applicability: 24 June 2026 bulletin explicitly says Transporter T6.1 Stage 1 is available after ECU unlock. The table lists 110 PS/250 Nm (+80 PS/+170 Nm), 150 PS/340 Nm (+40 PS/+80 Nm), and 204 PS/450 Nm (+26 PS/+50 Nm). Broad model/year list is not sufficient to assign those outputs to every listed VAG van. Stock torque differs from the current ATM 150 PS/360 Nm application; do not combine them.
